# Rough Notation

Rough Notation 0.5.1 by Preet Shihn, MIT licensed.

Vendored browser build: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/rough-notation@0.5.1/lib/rough-notation.iife.js
Upstream: https://github.com/rough-stuff/rough-notation

Loaded locally by `index.html` for the circle, strike-through and crossed-off word marks in Fix the time. The library is unchanged. See `LICENSE` for copyright and licensing terms.
